public.title: Template Engine II
public.description: input {template,data}; placeholders are {{a.b}} for escaped output and {{{a.b}}} for raw output. Paths consist of dot-separated safe alphanumeric keys; missing/null values produce empty strings, others are strings or integers and stringify normally. Escape ampersand, less/greater signs, double/single quotes. Process placeholders once from source left to right; replacement text is never reparsed. Unmatched text is literal. Template length at most 300, values at most 60 characters. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Scan placeholders with one replacement pass and resolve each path using own-key lookup. O(template length plus path traversal and escaped output) time and output-sized space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
